config.omniminer.title: omniminer Config
config.omniminer.serverManaged: Mining behavior is managed by this server. Server operators can change it with /omniminer set.
config.omniminer.maxBlocks.tooltip: Maximum number of blocks to break at once
config.omniminer.searchDiagonal.tooltip: Search diagonally (26 directions) instead of just adjacent (6 directions)
config.omniminer.autoCollect.tooltip: Automatically collect dropped items to inventory
config.omniminer.breakLeaves.tooltip: Also break connected leaves when chopping trees
config.omniminer.includeBlockEntities.to: Allow vein mining blocks with block entities, such as chests. Disabled by default for safety.
config.omniminer.toggleMode.tooltip: Press key to toggle on/off (instead of holding)
config.omniminer.outlineColor.tooltip: Color of the block highlight outline
config.omniminer.showBlocksMinedCount.to: Display the number of blocks mined after breaking
config.omniminer.showBlocksPreview.toolt: Display the number of blocks that will be mined before breaking
config.omniminer.outlineThickness.toolti: Thickness of the block highlight outline (1.0 - 5.0)
config.omniminer.bedrockSneakEnable.tool: Bedrock Edition players can activate vein mining by sneaking (crouching)
config.omniminer.bedrockAllowKeyBind.too: Also allow Bedrock Edition players to use keybind (if GeyserMC supports it)
config.omniminer.bedrockShowParticles.to: Show particle effects to indicate vein mining range for Bedrock players
config.omniminer.bedrockParticleMode.too: Corner: Show particles at block corners only (lighter). Detailed: Show full outline (more particles)
